body: As I sit there watching my co-op partner absentmindedly scrolling through their phone, something clicks inside me—a mix of curiosity and irritation. The lack of engagement during our meetings feels like an unspoken warning sign. My pulse quickens at the thought of probing deeper into why they haven't participated fully yet again.
